Class UnescoWhymapAquiferRasterizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.UnescoWhymapAquiferRasterizer
public final class UnescoWhymapAquiferRasterizer extends Object
Cartographic rasterizer for UNESCO WHYMAP global groundwater aquifers, river networks, and paleo-recharge pluvial dynamics across historical epochs.
